notes.title: Recommendation letter
notes.notes:
This game is super fun! ! !
With a rich combat system, it is challenging and interesting to decrypt the levels. When you get rare items, you will feel a sense of accomplishment
The plot is also more unexpected than it seems on the surface. There are many hidden easter eggs on the border of the map to explore.
Ask me why I blow up this game so much? Because I am the developer haha, come and play!
